scripts.build: npm install && npx shadow-cljs release app && npx webpack --config-name app
scripts.test: npx shadow-cljs release test && npx webpack --config-name test && karma start --single-run
scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p docs/js/libs/vs docs/css docs/js/libs/monaco-esm && cp -r node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs/* docs/js/libs/vs/ && cp -r node_modules/monaco-editor/esm/* docs/js/libs/monaco-esm/ && cp node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/sqlite-wasm/jswasm/sqlite3.js docs/js/libs/ && cp node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/sqlite-wasm/jswasm/sqlite3.wasm docs/js/libs/
